context.description: The blend format README answers questions 1, 3 and 4 in a Validation section

evidence.trustReason: The four tests extract the real README Validation section and assert every requested heading and claim. The before-work/refusal test runs TaskCommand with an invalid folder and dirty checkout, checks loader precedence, refusal lines, run.reason and no job. The rule test requires exactly R1-R13 in order, a real source path with the rule marker for each, and runtime R12 versus load checks. The order test folds the loaded cascade plan through the engine and loads cycle, self-after, unknown-reference and ancestor/descendant faults to check the stated behaviour. The folder test requires all eight on-disk examples, checks five loader refusals through /task, checks the sixth outside-run subtree R12 refusal and whole-spec start, and loads both live-check folders. Four tests passed with 172 assertions.
